story_format.i_want: Update the current API implementation to utilize a real SQL database connection with connection string managed by configuration
story_format.so_that: The application can persist data reliably across application restarts and support production-grade data storage instead of in-memory repositories

raw_request: User request: Update current @[app/src/api] implementation to utilize a real SQL db connection, with connection string managed by config

target_persona.role: Developer maintaining the financial application backend
target_persona.permissions: Full access to database configuration and API codebase
target_persona.context: Responsible for ensuring data persistence and configuration management across environments

capability_breakdown.core_action: Replace in-memory repositories with SQL database-backed repositories
outputs_expected: Functional SQL repositories implementing ITransactionRepository and IAccountRepository
state_changes: Data persisted to SQL database instead of in-memory
Account and transaction data survives application restarts
side_effects: Seed data may need to be loaded into SQL database
Application startup may require database availability

acceptance_criteria.criterion: SQL repositories implement the same interfaces as in-memory repositories
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the API is configured with a SQL database connection, When a transaction is created, Then it is persisted to the SQL database

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Connection string is read from appsettings.json configuration
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given appsettings.json contains a valid connection string, When the application starts, Then it connects to the specified SQL database

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Database context is properly registered in dependency injection
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the application is configured with DbContext, When repositories are instantiated, Then they receive a valid ApplicationDbContext instance

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing API endpoints continue to work with SQL-backed repositories
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the API endpoints are unchanged, When requests are made to transaction and account endpoints, Then they retrieve/persist data from/to SQL database

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Account and transaction data models are properly mapped to database entities
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the Account and Transaction domain models exist, When data is persisted to SQL, Then the schema correctly represents the domain model

edge_cases: Connection string is missing or invalid
Concurrent access to database from multiple application instances
dependencies: Entity Framework Core is already referenced in the project
SQL Server provider for Entity Framework Core
Database must be accessible at the connection string specified
open_questions: Should existing in-memory seed data be migrated to SQL database?
What is the target SQL database (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, SQLite)?
Should database migrations be automated or manual?
What is the database schema design for Account and Transaction entities?
